step1_figure.circuit_type: Comparator preamplification stage and positive feedback decision circuit
step1_figure.description: The circuit consists of an NMOS differential pair (M1, M2) with diode-connected PMOS loads (M31, M41) mirrored via M3 and M4 into an NMOS positive feedback decision circuit (M5-M8) with tail current source biased by a beta-multiplier reference.

tail_current.description: Tail bias current Iss supplied to the input differential pair

equation.explanation: Nominal tail bias current set by the bias circuit (SUB_1) through the tail current mirror transistor xmsu3.
equation.assumptions: Bias circuit properly started up and stabilized.

sky130_expected.calculation: Iss is set to 40 uA nominal as specified in Fig 27.5.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard biasing variation across process corners.

decision_circuit_voh.description: Maximum output voltage vop when all tail current is steered to one side

equation.explanation: When M8 and M6 are off, all mirrored current iop flows through diode-connected NMOS M5.
equation.assumptions: M8 and M6 are completely turned off, vom approx 0V.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on the threshold voltage VTHN and effective transconductance parameter beta_A of M5.

high_switching_threshold.description: Upper switching point voltage VSPH where decision circuit flips as vp increases

equation.formula: VSPH = vp - vm = (Iss / gm) * ((beta_B / beta_A - 1) / (beta_B / beta_A + 1))
equation.explanation: Input differential voltage at which the decision circuit switches when beta_B >= beta_A.
equation.assumptions: M8 gate-source voltage reaches VTHN at the trip point; Iss = 40 uA.

sky130_expected.calculation: For W5=W8=10u/1u (beta_A), W6=W7=12u/1u (beta_B), beta_B/beta_A = 1.2. Differential pair ID = 20 uA with W/L = 10u/2u = 5: gm = sqrt(2 * 270u * 5 * 20u) = 232.4 uA/V. VSPH = (40u / 232.4u) * ((1.2 - 1) / (1.2 + 1)) = 0.1721 * (0.2 / 2.2) = 15.6 mV.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by gm of input pair and beta ratio (1.2).

low_switching_threshold.description: Lower switching point voltage VSPL where decision circuit flips as vp decreases

equation.explanation: Due to circuit symmetry, the lower switching threshold is equal in magnitude and opposite in sign to VSPH.
equation.assumptions: Fully symmetric differential pair and decision circuit layout.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Equal and opposite to VSPH by differential symmetry.

hysteresis_voltage.description: Total input hysteresis voltage width of the comparator

equation.explanation: Total difference between the upper and lower input switching thresholds.
equation.assumptions: beta_B > beta_A creating positive feedback latching.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Double the individual switching point voltage.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench measuring bias current, output high level, VSPH, VSPL, and hysteresis voltage of the pre-amp and decision circuit.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Pre-amp and Decision Circuit (Baker Fig. 27.5)
.lib "/home/designer/sky130_pdk/sky130_fd_pr/models/sky130.lib.spice" tt

* Parameter definitions matching Fig. 27.5 / Ex. 27.1
.param W_xmsu3=20u L_xmsu3=2u
.param W_xm31=30u  L_xm31=2u
.param W_xm41=30u  L_xm41=2u
.param W_xm2=10u   L_xm2=2u
.param W_xm1=10u   L_xm1=2u
.param W_xm3=30u   L_xm3=2u
.param W_xm4=30u   L_xm4=2u
.param W_xm5=10u   L_xm5=1u
.param W_xm6=12u   L_xm6=1u
.param W_xm7=12u   L_xm7=1u
.param W_xm8=10u   L_xm8=1u

* Parameters for SUB_1 reference
.param W_xmsu2=5u  L_xmsu2=2u
.param W_xmsu1=5u  L_xmsu1=2u

* Circuit Netlist (DUT)
VDD VDD 0 1.8
xmsu3 N003 Vbiasn 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xmsu3} l={L_xmsu3}
xm31 N002 N002 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm31} l={L_xm31}
xm41 N001 N001 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm41} l={L_xm41}
xm2 N001 vm N003 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm2} l={L_xm2}
xm1 N002 vp N003 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm1} l={L_xm1}
X_U1 Vbiasn Vbiasp VDD 0 SUB_1
Vp vp 0 0.9
Vm vm 0 0.9
xm3 vop N002 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm3} l={L_xm3}
xm4 vom N001 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm4} l={L_xm4}
xm5 vop vop 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm5} l={L_xm5}
xm6 vop vom 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm6} l={L_xm6}
xm7 vom vop 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm7} l={L_xm7}
xm8 vom vom 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm8} l={L_xm8}

.subckt SUB_1 Vbiasn Vbiasp VDD GND
  xmsu2 N001 N001 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xmsu2} l={L_xmsu2}
  xmsu1 N001 Vbiasn 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xmsu1} l={L_xmsu1}
  xmsu3 VDD N001 Vbiasn 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xmsu3} l={L_xmsu3}
  xm3 Vbiasn Vbiasp VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm3} l={L_xm3}
  xm4 Vbiasp Vbiasp VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm4} l={L_xm4}
  xm1 Vbiasn Vbiasn 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm1} l={L_xm1}
  xm2 Vbiasp Vbiasn N002 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm2} l={L_xm2}
  R1 N002 GND 6.5k
.ends SUB_1

* Dynamic stimulus for hysteresis extraction via slow triangular wave
Vp_dyn vp_dyn 0 PWL(0 0.8 100u 1.0 200u 0.8)
Bvp vp 0 V = v(vp_dyn)

.control
* 1. Operating Point to check Iss tail current
op
let iss_val = @m.xmsu3.msky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8[id]
print iss_val

* 2. Transient analysis over triangular sweep to capture hysteresis
tran 100n 200u

* Differential output
let vdiff = v(vop) - v(vom)
let vid = v(vp) - v(vm)

* Forward switching (vp ramping up: 0 to 100us)
meas tran vsph_time when vdiff=0 rise=1
meas tran vsph find vid at=vsph_time

* Reverse switching (vp ramping down: 100us to 200us)
meas tran vspl_time when vdiff=0 fall=1
meas tran vspl find vid at=vspl_time

* Hysteresis calculation
let vhys = vsph - vspl
print vsph vspl vhys

* 3. Max output high level of decision circuit
meas tran voh_max max v(vop)
print voh_max

quit
.endc
.end
